project_type: Python FastAPI web application (multi-event flight card scanner)
language: Python 3.12 (project requires 3.12+; 3.9 also on PATH but do NOT use it)
build_system: Python via pip (no pyproject/setup.cfg; deps installed explicitly) plus pnpm for client JS assets (opencv.js, thrustcurve-db). No packaging metadata file exists.
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio. Tests live under tests/. Async tests use @pytest.mark.asyncio and httpx.AsyncClient with ASGITransport, or starlette TestClient. There is NO conftest.py and NO pytest.ini/pyproject pytest config; pytest-asyncio runs the marked tests in its default mode. Existing tests build ad-hoc FastAPI apps and mock the session middleware (see tests/test_multi_event_routing.py _MockSessionMiddleware).
build_command: python3.12 -m pip install fastapi 'uvicorn[standard]' sqlalchemy aiosqlite httpx pydantic jinja2 python-multipart pillow rapidfuzz segno itsdangerous argon2-cffi pytest pytest-asyncio hypothesis  &&  pnpm install
test_command: python3.12 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider   (full suite ~2 min). For the feature specifically: python3.12 -m pytest tests/test_decoy_404.py tests/test_multi_event_routing.py -q
verification_instructions: 1) Ensure deps installed and 'pnpm install' has run (thrustcurve-db + opencv.js must be present under flight_card_scanner/static/js/node_modules, otherwise many app-level tests error). 2) Run the new feature tests. 3) Run the full suite and confirm no NEW failures beyond the known 5 pre-existing failures listed in environment_constraints.
snapshot_or_generated_files: pnpm install populates flight_card_scanner/static/js/node_modules/{opencv.js,thrustcurve-db}. These are gitignored generated deps, not checked in. No other generated/snapshot files.
setup_instructions: Use python3.12 (via pyenv shim already on PATH). Install the Python deps listed in build_command, then run 'pnpm install' at repo root. FCS_SESSION_SECRET is required to actually boot the full app but is NOT needed for the isolated tests, which construct their own FastAPI app instances.
environment_constraints: Network access to package registries IS available (pip install and pnpm install both work). Known PRE-EXISTING baseline failures (present before this task, do NOT attempt to fix, must not be counted as regressions): (a) tests/test_bedrock_endpoint.py::TestCallBedrock::test_call_bedrock_raises_on_api_failure - missing optional 'botocore' dep; (b) tests/test_event_manager.py::TestOpenCloseEvent::test_open_event_sets_state and ::test_open_already_open_is_noop and ::TestGetEvent::test_get_event_opens_if_closed - async-mock/ordering issues; (c) tests/test_audit_service.py::TestInitAuditLogger::test_file_handler_uses_append_mode - flaky under full-run ordering (passes in isolation). Baseline full run = 550 passed, 5 failed.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md. README documents run/test conventions. Commit on a working branch; do NOT push or open a PR (orchestrator publishes). Follow existing test style (httpx.AsyncClient + ASGITransport, or starlette TestClient; mock session middleware like _MockSessionMiddleware).
key_patterns: App factory in flight_card_scanner/main.py. Two existing global middlewares registered via @app.middleware('http'): read_only_guard and session_resolution. session_resolution sets request.state.user (None if not logged in), request.state.session_token, request.state.clear_session_cookie BEFORE call_next. IMPORTANT Starlette ordering: the LAST-added @app.middleware runs OUTERMOST (first on request). So to have request.state.user populated when a new decoy middleware inspects the response, the decoy middleware must be added in code BEFORE session_resolution (so session_resolution ends up outer and runs first). 404s arise two ways: (1) no route matches an arbitrary/bogus path (FastAPI returns a default 404 JSON), (2) a handler raises HTTPException(404) e.g. get_event_info (dependencies/event.py) for unknown event slug, serve_event_image in main.py for missing image, admin/review/reports for missing records. Static files mounted at /static. Top-level routes: '/' (events list), '/login','/logout','/register','/admin/users' (auth), '/lost-rockets'. Event-scoped routes under '/events/{event_path:path}/...' including '/events/{slug}/images/{filename:path}'. A 404.html Jinja template exists (uses base.html) but the decoy must NOT use it - the decoy returns raw text.
relevant_files: flight_card_scanner/main.py (app factory, existing @app.middleware http handlers, event_router, serve_event_image; ADD the new decoy middleware here)
flight_card_scanner/dependencies/auth.py (Role, require_role, request.state.user usage; study only)
flight_card_scanner/dependencies/event.py (raises HTTPException 404 for unknown event slug)
flight_card_scanner/routers/events.py, routers/auth.py, routers/lost_rockets.py (top-level route prefixes to recognize)
tests/test_multi_event_routing.py (canonical example of building a test app + mocking session middleware + AsyncClient usage; MODEL NEW TESTS ON THIS)
directory_structure: flight_card_scanner/ = the package (main.py app factory, routers/, middleware/, dependencies/, services/, templates/, static/). tests/ = pytest suite. Root has README.md, DEPLOY.md, Dockerfile, compose.yaml, config.json, package.json + pnpm-lock.yaml for client assets.
